lane: SGA6 page-unit harness and Weber live audit method snapshots
publication_decision: Pending workflow DOI refresh. These are reusable method/support artifacts, not edition certification.

local_files.scope: SGA6 page-unit audit harness: canonical French cumulative TeX, original scan path, piecewise printed/PDF page map, Kimi OCR locator-only warning, manifest, and chunk script.
Weber live find-verify-fix method and certification logs through the current p527 German Vol. I workpass edge.

lessons: Build audit harnesses around the best cumulative TeX plus source scan, not around raw OCR drops.
OCR/Kimi drops are useful as locator layers only unless source-specific audit promotes them.
For Weber-like GPT drafts, audit first for omissions, compression, and fabricated prose, not just symbol drift.
Agents are finders; certification requires independent source verification, exact patching, and compile/page-count gates.
caveat: Workflow artifacts only. They do not certify SGA6, Weber, SGA5, or any author record as complete or critical.
next_action: Include these two compact ZIPs and update the workflow record description in the next Zenodo workflow DOI refresh.
